description_en: Updates the authorization mode of usage permissions for a digital employee
description_zh: 更新数字员工使用权限授权模式
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo update-agent-auth-mode --operating-object-name string_value --auth-mode SPECIFIED_USERS --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAgentAuthMode

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant where the operation takes effect
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital employee, which is the name of the operating object. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称（运营对象 name，可选）
parameters.name: operating_object_name

200.description_en: 更新数字员工使用权限授权模式
200.description_zh: 更新数字员工使用权限授权模式

schema.description_en: The response body for updating the authorization mode of a digital employee
schema.description_zh: 更新数字员工授权模式响应体

message.description_en: The description of the status code
